Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1196
Claimant:
Susan Walton
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
6-7-25
First notice of loss received from the claimant, who reports a low-speed collision while the vehicle was parked and
backing out of a stall in a shopping center lot.
7-4-25
Claimant is not represented by an attorney. Confirmed the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in
force at the time of the loss.
7-14-25
Requested photos of the vehicle and the lot from the claimant. Photos were received and show damage consistent
with a rear-quarter impact.
8-15-25
Spoke with the other driver, who gave an account matching the claimant's description of how the two vehicles came
together.
10-10-25
Police report reviewed. The responding officer lists the claimant as an occupant of the vehicle, and two independent
witnesses are named in the report.
10-23-25
Obtained statements from both witnesses, who confirm the collision happened as described and that the claimant
was in the driver's seat.
10-28-25
Claimant reports a knee injury from the impact and has started a course of treatment with a provider of their choosing.
Treatment notes requested.
11-4-25
Reviewed the damage estimate. The repair scope is mostly in line with the impact the photos and statements
describe. No prior damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the prior claims search.
11-13-25
Treatment notes received. The injury fits the kind and force of the crash, and care followed a usual course, easing off
as the claimant improved.
12-13-25
Claimant disclosed a small strain to the same area several years ago that healed fully. Nothing in the file suggests the
current injury was caused by anything other than this collision.
12-21-25
Claimant has given the same account in every conversation so far. Nothing points to dmaage predating the start of
coverage. Claim is progressing to settlement review.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
